description: Stream Live IPTV, Video On-Demand, and Series from an Xtream-compatible server using this plugin.
name: Jelly Xtream
overview: Stream content from an Xtream-compatible server.

versions.changelog:
Jellyfin.Xtream v0.10.0 adds support for Jellyfin Server 12.1.

- Target .NET 10 and Jellyfin.Common/Controller/Model 12.1.0.
- Set the plugin catalog ABI to 12.1.0.0 and update the build, test, and publish workflows.
- Avoid evaluating disabled log arguments under the .NET 10 analyzers and document coordinated restream transport ownership.

Validation: all 147 tests pass in both Debug and Release on .NET 10; release metadata checks pass. Live playback against a running Jellyfin 12.1 server has not been exercised.

Requires Jellyfin 12.1 or later. For Jellyfin 10.11, continue using v0.9.12. Install through the plugin catalog and restart Jellyfin after upgrading.
Use verified TMDB IDs and release years for conservative VOD STRM deduplication. Export managed movie NFO sidecars to prevent incorrect filename-based Jellyfin metadata matches.
Improve STRM title deduplication and add an on-demand deduplication task.

Keep successful STRM output ownership in the manifest when a provider has partial failures. This allows later successful exports to reconcile stale paths without deleting output during an incomplete run.

Fix STRM export reconciliation after title cleanup changes. Legacy Xtream-tagged paths for returned VOD and series identities are now removed after a successful export. Also accepts provider series records with a null `episode_count`.
Restores normalized VOD STRM deduplication with 4K and Dutch preference, and exposes the VOD deduplication switch again.

- Restore the visible, enabled STRM export scheduled task.\n- Remove the task-hiding safeguard that could leave side-by-side installations with no visible export action.\n- Keep newest-assembly selection when configuration queues a STRM export.

- Add separate regex editors for category, Live TV, movie, and series names.\n- Automatically scope each editor to the matching content type.\n- Preserve existing global and advanced scoped cleanup rules.

- Remove the retired pre-v0.9 STRM migration and quarantine workflow.\n- Remove its dashboard controls, API endpoints, service implementation, and tests.\n- Keep normal v0.9 STRM export and manifest reconciliation unchanged.

- Prevent duplicate scheduled STRM exports when multiple plugin versions are loaded.\n- Always queue the STRM export task from the newest loaded plugin assembly.\n- Document safe catalog updates that preserve the existing plugin configuration.

- Add opt-in series title deduplication for the Xtream channel and STRM export.\n- Skip duplicate series before episode details are fetched during export.\n- Reconcile stale plugin-managed STRM files after a successful deduplicated export.

Hotfix release for Live TV playback through providers that redirect stream URLs to public CDN hosts.

Changes:
- Allow Live TV stream/restream requests to follow public cross-origin provider redirects.
- Keep Xtream API/metadata requests on strict same-origin redirect handling.
- Reject redirects to private/local/metadata endpoints even for stream playback.
- Bump plugin metadata to 0.9.2.0.

Verification:
- dotnet test Jellyfin.Xtream.sln -c Release: 142 passed.
- Deployed build was verified on Jellyfin with Live TV playback-info returning HTTP 200 and no new origin errors.
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pietermn/Jellyfin.Xtream/compare/v0.9.0...v0.9.1
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pietermn/Jellyfin.Xtream/compare/v0.8.12...v0.9.0
Handle Xtream provider HTTP errors cleanly and deduplicate STRM exports by stable stream, series, episode IDs, and cleaned export titles.
Handle Xtream provider HTTP errors cleanly and deduplicate STRM exports by stable stream, series, and episode IDs.
Retry transient Xtream API request failures such as connection resets during STRM export.
Improve scheduled STRM export progress reporting during VOD and series file writes.
Harden STRM export paths, skip unchanged writes, remove stale STRM files after clean exports, and keep exporting after item-level failures.
Fix STRM export for Xtream providers that return series episodes as nested arrays.
Fix STRM export for Xtream providers that return series episodes as a flat array.
Adds optional STRM export for selected movies and series alongside existing channel functionality.
Adds configurable regex cleanup rules for Live TV, movie, series, season, episode, and category names.
Custom build with improved live restream buffering, safer live buffer synchronization, configured User-Agent on stream requests, and Jellyfin 10.11.11 dependency updates.
